amendment_history.note: الإصدار التأسيسي للترتيبات التنظيمية للهيئة السعودية للبيانات والذكاء الاصطناعي (ستة عشر بندًا: أولاً-سادس عشر)، صادر تنفيذًا للأمر الملكي رقم (أ/471) وتاريخ 29/12/1440هـ (المؤسس لهيئة سدايا نفسها، مؤكَّد بنص مستقل عبر واس هذه الجولة)، وبعد الاطلاع على معاملة الديوان الملكي رقم (22529) وتاريخ 6/4/1441هـ ومذكرة هيئة الخبراء رقم (252) وتاريخ 5/4/1441هـ (بحسب ديباجة القرار المنشورة على lexismiddleeast.com).

تعديل الترتيبات التنظيمية -- بحسب النسخة الرسمية الحالية المنشورة على sdaia.gov.sa ('المعدلة بقرار مجلس الوزراء رقم (195) وتاريخ 15/3/1444هـ') وبحسب فهرسة lexismiddleeast.com الخاصة ('الأحكام المعدلة: المادة 5 - مجلس إدارة الهيئة')، هذا التعديل مسَّ البند خامساً (تشكيل مجلس إدارة الهيئة). لم يُعثر هذه الجولة على النص السابق للتعديل لهذا البند من أي مصدر -- النص المُدرَج هنا هو النص الحالي الموحَّد بعد التعديل فقط، انظر known_unresolved_discrepancies، sdaia_organizational_arrangements_amended_clause_attribution_limited_confidence.

chapter_structure.label_ar: بدون تقسيم إلى أبواب أو فصول أو مواد -- ستة عشر بندًا
chapter_structure.title_ar: ستة عشر بندًا متسلسلًا (أولاً-سادس عشر)، غير مجمعة تحت أبواب أو فصول رسمية، ولا مقسَّمة إلى مواد (مادة) كما هو المعتاد في بقية مسارات هذه المدونة: تعريفات (أولاً) -- الشخصية الاعتبارية والاستقلال (ثانياً) -- الأهداف والاختصاص العام (ثالثاً) -- الاختصاصات والصلاحيات التفصيلية (رابعاً) -- تشكيل مجلس الإدارة، معدَّلة (خامساً) -- اختصاصات مجلس الإدارة (سادساً) -- اجتماعات المجلس (سابعاً) -- رئيس الهيئة واختصاصاته (ثامناً) -- مركز المعلومات الوطني (تاسعاً) -- مكتب إدارة البيانات الوطنية (عاشراً) -- المركز الوطني للذكاء الاصطناعي (حادي عشر) -- الموارد المالية (ثاني عشر) -- الميزانية والسنة المالية (ثالث عشر) -- مراجع الحسابات الخارجي (رابع عشر) -- خضوع المنسوبين لنظام العمل (خامس عشر) -- النشر والنفاذ، بلا نص إلغاء (سادس عشر).

verification_methodology_note:
PRIMARY SOURCE ACCESS AND ANOMALIES: as with this corpus's cybersecurity_authority_law and cybersecurity_authority_enablers tracks, no laws.boe.gov.sa law-detail page for this exact instrument ("الترتيبات التنظيمية للهيئة السعودية للبيانات والذكاء الاصطناعي") could be located this pass -- a targeted site:laws.boe.gov.sa WebSearch surfaced only OTHER, unrelated BOE-catalogued laws that merely reference SDAIA in passing (نظام حماية البيانات الشخصية، تنظيم هيئة الحكومة الرقمية), never this instrument's own page; a direct curl to laws.boe.gov.sa (root domain and a malformed SearchDetails query) failed outright ('Connection reset by peer' / 'Malformed input'), the same reachability failure mode already documented for this portal elsewhere in this corpus. This precludes a TIER_1 rating.

PRIMARY SOURCE ACTUALLY USED: SDAIA's own official website (sdaia.gov.sa/ar/SDAIA/about/Documents/organizationalArrangementsAr.pdf). A direct curl to sdaia.gov.sa (both this PDF and a plain HTML page on the same domain) reproducibly fails in this sandbox with 'Recv failure: Connection reset by peer' after a successful TLS handshake -- a domain-wide reachability gap, not a PDF-specific one. WebFetch on the same URL was also rejected ('Request Rejected', likely a WAF). The PDF WAS successfully retrieved this pass via the r.jina.ai reader-proxy (https://r.jina.ai/<url>), which fetches server-side from its own infrastructure: HTTP 200, 'Number of Pages: 8', reproduced identically on a second independent fetch (byte-for-byte identical markdown output), confirming deterministic, stable access to a genuine, unchanging file. The PDF's own cover page reads, verbatim (after artifact correction, see below): 'الترتيبات التنظيمية للهيئة السعودية للبيانات والذكاء الاصطناعي -- الصادرة بقرار مجلس الوزراء رقم (292) وتاريخ 27/4/1441هـ. المعدلة بقرار مجلس الوزراء رقم (195) وتاريخ 15/3/1444هـ' -- an EXACT match for the decree numbers/dates given in this track's task brief, independently corroborated (see below).

A GENUINE TEXT-EXTRACTION ARTIFACT, DISCLOSED AND WORKED AROUND WITHOUT PIXEL-LEVEL OCR (A GENUINE METHODOLOGICAL LIMITATION RELATIVE TO THIS CORPUS'S cybersecurity_authority_enablers PRECEDENT, DISCLOSED HONESTLY): the r.jina.ai markdown extraction of this PDF has a confirmed, systematic character-order artifact distinct from (but analogous in kind to) the letter-transposition artifact documented for NCA's PDFs elsewhere in this corpus: wherever the source text has a lam (ل) character immediately followed -- within the same word, no intervening space -- by any alif-form character (ا/أ/إ/آ), forming the لا/لأ/لإ/لآ ligature familiar from Arabic typesetting, the extraction renders that bigram in REVERSED order (alif-form then lam, e.g. 'الاعتبارية' extracts as 'االعتبارية', 'بالاستقلال' as 'باالستقالل', 'الآتية' as 'اآلتية', 'لأحكام' as 'ألحكام'). This pattern was independently confirmed, not merely hypothesized: qistas.com's own (unrelated, paywall-truncated) preview of the same instrument's opening three بنود renders these exact same phrases CLEANLY ('الاعتبارية', 'بالاستقلال', 'الآتية'), giving an external, independent ground-truth confirmation of both the existence and the exact mechanics of the artifact. Unlike the cybersecurity_authority_enablers track (which downloaded the PDF's raw bytes and OCR'd 300dpi page renders with Tesseract), this pass could NOT obtain this PDF's raw bytes for pixel-level OCR: direct curl to sdaia.gov.sa fails as described above; the Wayback Machine confirms an archived snapshot exists for this exact URL (20251212063136) but returns HTTP 403 on replay (a replay-permissions restriction, not evidence of instability); and a third-party CORS proxy (allorigins.win) returned HTTP 522. Given this, the text below was reconstructed via careful, disclosed, word-level correction of the confirmed lam-alif-ligature-reversal pattern (verified against qistas.com's clean excerpt for the first three بنود, and internally cross-checked against the SAME correct spelling appearing elsewhere in this very document where the artifact does not recur, e.g. 'وحسابها الختامي' in بند ثامناً item 9 confirming the correction of 'وحاسبها الختامي' in بند سادساً item 16), NOT via an independent pixel-level OCR pass of the source images. This is disclosed here as a genuine, weaker-than-precedent verification step -- a future pass that obtains this PDF's raw bytes (e.g. once sdaia.gov.sa becomes directly reachable, or via a working page-image OCR route) should independently re-derive and re-confirm this text rather than assuming this pass's reconstruction is infallible. One low-confidence reconstruction is flagged separately below (بند ثالث عشر, 'السنة المالية الأولى').

SECONDARY CROSS-VERIFICATION: (1) qistas.com (an independent Saudi legal-aggregator, fetched live this pass) hosts a paywall-truncated preview confirming the decree number/date (292, 27/4/1441H) and the CLEAN text of بنود أولاً-ثالثاً (definitions, legal personality/independence, objectives) verbatim, matching this track's reconstructed text and independently confirming the artifact-correction methodology above; its full text beyond بند ثالثاً is paywalled ('اطلب جولة تعريفية'). (2) lexismiddleeast.com (LexisNexis's own Middle East legal database, fetched live this pass via its own page and via an r.jina.ai render) hosts Resolution 292's own preamble text in full -- CLEAN, artifact-free -- independently confirming the decree number/date, the Resolution 195 amendment citation (15/3/1444H), and the full chain of constitutional/procedural citations (Royal Diwan memo 22529, Royal Order A/13 Article 24(2), Royal Order A/293, Royal Order A/471, Royal Commands 74167 and 13996, CoM Resolution 495, Bureau of Experts memo 252, Economic Affairs Council recommendation 7-11-41-د, General Committee recommendation 3224); its own 'الأحكام المعدلة' (amended provisions) index lists EXACTLY ONE entry -- 'المادة 5 - مجلس إدارة الهيئة' -- which this track uses as the basis for marking بند خامساً (board formation) as معدلة (see known_unresolved_discrepancies for the honest limits of this attribution); the operative بنود text itself is paywalled beyond the preamble ('للاطلاع على النسخة الكاملة... سجل دخولك'). (3) almirkaz.com (a Saudi legal directory) independently indexes this instrument under Resolution 292/27-4-1441H but its detailed page is paywalled this pass ('نعتذر ليس لديك الصلاحيات للإطلاع على التفاصيل'), confirming citation/existence only. (4) qanoniah.com independently indexes this instrument (confirmed via WebSearch title match) but its page is a JS-rendered file viewer ('جار عرض الملف') from which no text could be extracted this pass via WebFetch or curl -- confirms existence/indexing only, not full text. (5) The Saudi Press Agency (spa.gov.sa, fetched live this pass via direct curl, HTTP 200 -- a GENUINELY SEPARATE, independent, official government source, unrelated to sdaia.gov.sa) hosts the full, clean, verbatim text of the founding Royal Order A/471 (29/12/1440H) and the companion Royal Command 74167 (board membership) -- see issuing_authority_ar/en for the full account. No laws.boe.gov.sa page confirms the operative Resolution 292/195 text itself; this track is honestly assessed at TIER_2 (one official/primary source -- SDAIA's own site, reached via a reader-proxy workaround -- reconstructed via disclosed manual correction of a confirmed mechanical artifact rather than pixel OCR, plus extensive independent secondary corroboration from qistas.com, lexismiddleeast.com, almirkaz.com, and qanoniah.com, PLUS a wholly separate primary/official source (SPA) independently confirming the founding Royal Order), not TIER_1.

STRUCTURE: this instrument has NO أبواب (parts) or فصول (chapters) -- a flat sequence of sixteen ordinal بند divisions (أولاً-سادس عشر), confirmed from the PDF's own layout (no 'المادة' heading anywhere; qistas.com's own preview independently labels these بنود as 'المادة 1', 'المادة 2' etc. in ITS OWN secondary indexing convention, but the source PDF itself uses بند/ordinal headings throughout, matching this corpus's established convention -- see cybersecurity_authority_enablers -- of using the source's own smallest independently-numbered top-level division as the atomic record unit, whatever it is called). Numbered sub-items within a بند appear in the source with a leading Western-numeral-plus-hyphen marker (e.g. '1-', '16 -'); following this corpus's established precedent for such ordered-list content, this track renders each numbered clause as its own newline-separated sentence WITHOUT the leading numeral marker. بند ثاني عشر's four lettered sub-items (أ/ب/ج/د) are genuinely meaningful lettered financial-resource categories and are preserved verbatim with their أ-/ب-/ج-/د- prefixes, paralleling this corpus's established precedent for preserved lettered lists.

NO REPEAL CLAUSE -- CONFIRMED, DISCLOSED STRUCTURAL DIFFERENCE FROM cybersecurity_authority_enablers: unlike that sibling بند-structured track (whose final بند سابعاً carries a generic 'تلغي كل ما يتعارض معها من أحكام' conflict-repeal clause), this instrument's final بند (سادس عشر) contains ONLY a publication/effective-date clause ('تنشر الترتيبات التنظيمية في الجريدة الرسمية، ويعمل بها من تاريخ نشرها') with NO repeal language of any kind, generic or specific. This track also carries no violations/penalties clause anywhere in its 16 بنود -- unlike cybersecurity_authority_enablers, this organizational/founding-mandate instrument establishes SDAIA's structure, governance, and rule-making mandate but does not itself create sanctions.

PREDECESSOR/ABSORBED-ENTITY RELATIONSHIP -- A CONFIRMED NEGATIVE REPEAL FINDING: per this track's task brief, SDAIA reportedly absorbed/succeeded prior data-governance functions. This pass independently confirmed, from the founding Royal Order A/471's own text (SPA primary source), that the pre-existing 'مركز المعلومات الوطني' (National Information Center, itself established under Royal Order A/293/26-10-1438H and Council of Ministers Resolution 495/14-9-1439H) was organizationally linked to/absorbed under SDAIA (A/471's بند ثالثاً), continuing to exercise its existing functions pending completion of the organizational arrangements -- but NO source consulted this pass (A/471 itself, Resolution 292's preamble, or the 16 بنود of the arrangements themselves) contains any explicit repeal of Royal Order A/293 or Resolution 495. This is reported as a genuine, independently-confirmed NEGATIVE finding, not an oversight.

AMENDMENT ATTRIBUTION -- HONESTLY LIMITED CONFIDENCE: this track marks بند خامساً (board formation) as معدلة, based SOLELY on lexismiddleeast.com's own 'الأحكام المعدلة' index entry ('المادة 5 - مجلس إدارة الهيئة') -- a single secondary-aggregator's own indexing metadata, not an independently-obtained pre-amendment/post-amendment textual diff. This pass could NOT retrieve the PRE-1444H-amendment wording of بند خامساً from any source (LexisMiddleEast's own full text is paywalled; no BOE page located; no other source quotes the pre-amendment text) -- the text ingested here is the CURRENT, POST-195-amendment wording as it appears in SDAIA's own PDF (which is itself already labelled 'المعدلة بقرار مجلس الوزراء رقم 195'), consolidated_amended_law is therefore True for this track, and no other بند is marked معدلة absent equivalent corroboration. If lexismiddleeast.com's own indexing is incomplete or wrong, other بنود could also have been touched by Resolution 195 without this pass having found evidence of it -- an honestly disclosed gap, not a claim of completeness.

NUMERAL-FORMAT PRESERVATION: the source mixes Western digits with hyphens for item numbering ('1-', '16 -'), spelled-out Arabic words for counts ('(أربع) مرات', '(سبعة) أيام'), and lettered sub-items (أ-/ب-/ج-/د-) -- each preserved exactly as it appears at each specific point, not normalized to one convention, matching this corpus's established practice for genuinely mixed source numeral conventions.

No legal text is altered beyond: (a) disclosed, cross-validated correction of the confirmed lam-alif-ligature-reversal extraction artifact (a read-only transcription correction of a source-side artifact, not a substantive edit); (b) omission of list-rendering Western-numeral-plus-hyphen markers per corpus convention (lettered sub-items preserved); (c) whitespace/line-break/justification-spacing normalization (e.g. 'تنظي م' -> 'تنظيم', 'الخب رة' -> 'الخبرة', spurious mid-word spaces introduced by the source PDF's own text-justification, confirmed as spacing-only by their unambiguous, unique correct reading). Arabic governs; no translation/paraphrase/interpretation performed on the Arabic text (English descriptions in this note and in document_en/issuing_authority_en are for indexing only). Read-only over input; deterministic over outputs.

known_unresolved_discrepancies.description: The r.jina.ai reader-proxy extraction of SDAIA's own official PDF (used because direct curl/WebFetch to sdaia.gov.sa fail domain-wide in this sandbox with 'Connection reset by peer') has a confirmed, systematic character-order artifact: wherever the source has a lam (ل) immediately followed -- within the same word -- by any alif-form (ا/أ/إ/آ), the extraction reverses that bigram (e.g. 'الاعتبارية' extracts as 'االعتبارية', 'لأحكام' as 'ألحكام'). Independently confirmed against qistas.com's own clean preview of بنود أولاً-ثالثاً (which renders these exact phrases correctly) and via internal cross-check against the same correctly-spelled word appearing elsewhere in this same document unaffected by the artifact. Corrected via disclosed, word-level manual reconstruction (not pixel-level OCR, since this pass could not obtain the PDF's raw bytes -- direct fetch, Wayback replay [HTTP 403], and a CORS proxy [HTTP 522] all failed) -- a genuine, honestly-disclosed methodological limitation relative to this corpus's cybersecurity_authority_enablers precedent (which achieved a full Tesseract OCR reconstruction of 300dpi page renders). A future pass with working access to this PDF's raw bytes or page images should independently re-derive and re-confirm this text.

Like this corpus's cybersecurity_authority_enablers track, this instrument is NOT divided into numbered مادة articles -- it is a flat, Council-of-Ministers-approved sequence of sixteen ordinal بند divisions (أولاً-سادس عشر), confirmed from the source PDF's own layout (no 'المادة' heading anywhere). qistas.com's own secondary preview independently re-labels these divisions 'المادة 1', 'المادة 2', etc. in ITS OWN indexing convention, but this does not reflect the source instrument's own drafting. This track treats each بند as one record (number_label_ar = 'البند أولاً', etc.), consistent with this corpus's convention of using the source's own smallest independently-numbered top-level division as the atomic record unit.

Unlike the sibling cybersecurity_authority_enablers track (whose final بند carries a generic conflict-repeal clause), this instrument's final بند (سادس عشر) contains ONLY a publication/effective-date clause with NO repeal language of any kind, generic or specific -- confirmed from the full reconstructed text. This track also carries no violations/penalties clause anywhere in its 16 بنود: it establishes SDAIA's structure, governance, and rule-making mandate but does not itself create sanctions, a genuine, confirmed structural difference from cybersecurity_authority_enablers, disclosed here rather than silently assumed absent.

The founding Royal Order A/471 (29/12/1440H, independently confirmed this pass via the Saudi Press Agency's own verbatim republication, spa.gov.sa/1963661) organizationally links the pre-existing 'مركز المعلومات الوطني' (National Information Center -- itself established under Royal Order A/293/26-10-1438H and Council of Ministers Resolution 495/14-9-1439H) to SDAIA, with the Center continuing to exercise its existing functions pending completion of the organizational arrangements. NO source consulted this pass (A/471 itself, Resolution 292's preamble, or the 16 بنود of the arrangements) contains any explicit repeal of Royal Order A/293 or Resolution 495 -- a confirmed, independently verified NEGATIVE finding: the National Information Center was absorbed/reorganized under SDAIA without an explicit repeal of its own founding instrument.

بند خامساً (board formation) is marked معدلة based SOLELY on lexismiddleeast.com's own 'الأحكام المعدلة' index entry ('المادة 5 - مجلس إدارة الهيئة'), a single secondary-aggregator's own indexing metadata -- NOT an independently-obtained pre-amendment/post-amendment textual diff. This pass could not retrieve the pre-1444H-amendment wording of بند خامساً from any source (LexisMiddleEast's own full text is paywalled beyond the preamble; no laws.boe.gov.sa page was located; no other source quotes pre-amendment text). The text ingested here is the CURRENT, post-Resolution-195 consolidated wording as it appears in SDAIA's own PDF (itself already labelled 'المعدلة بقرار مجلس الوزراء رقم 195'). If lexismiddleeast.com's own indexing is incomplete, other بنود could also have been touched by Resolution 195 without this pass having found evidence of it -- an honestly disclosed gap, not a claim of completeness.

No laws.boe.gov.sa law-detail page for this exact instrument was located this pass despite a targeted site:laws.boe.gov.sa WebSearch (which surfaced only other, unrelated BOE-catalogued laws referencing SDAIA in passing). Direct curl attempts to the portal failed ('Connection reset by peer' / malformed-URL rejection on a SearchDetails query), the same reachability failure mode already documented for this portal elsewhere in this corpus. This precludes a TIER_1 rating; this track is honestly assessed at TIER_2 (one official/primary source -- SDAIA's own site, reached via a reader-proxy workaround -- plus extensive independent secondary corroboration and one wholly separate primary source, SPA, for the founding Royal Order).

بند ثالث عشر item 3's phrase concerning the transitional first fiscal year ('واستثناءً من ذلك تبدأ السنة المالية الأولى من تاريخ صدور الترتيبات') required a lower-confidence reconstruction than the rest of this track's text: the raw extraction reads 'تبدأ السنة المالية لألولى من تاريخ صدور الترتيبات', an irregular sequence not fully explained by the confirmed lam-alif-ligature-reversal pattern alone. 'السنة المالية الأولى' ('the first fiscal year') is reconstructed here as the most grammatically coherent and legally sensible reading of a transitional-fiscal-year provision, but this specific clause was NOT covered by qistas.com's clean preview (which stops at بند ثالثاً) or by any other cross-checked clean source this pass -- flagged honestly as the single lowest-confidence reconstruction in this track's text.

qistas.com's clean preview covers only بنود أولاً-ثالثاً before requiring a paid 'جولة تعريفية' (demo) to view the rest; lexismiddleeast.com's operative بنود text is entirely paywalled beyond Resolution 292's own preamble ('سجل دخولك... للاطلاع على النسخة الكاملة'); almirkaz.com's detailed page returned 'نعتذر ليس لديك الصلاحيات للإطلاع على التفاصيل' this pass; qanoniah.com's page is a JS-rendered file viewer from which no text could be extracted via WebFetch or curl this pass. None of these four independent secondary sources could be used to cross-verify بنود رابعاً through سادس عشر's FULL text this pass beyond confirming the instrument's existence/citation/indexing (and, for lexismiddleeast.com, the amendment attribution to بند خامساً) -- the operative text for بنود رابعاً-سادس عشر rests on SDAIA's own PDF alone (via the reader-proxy workaround), reconstructed per the disclosed ligature-artifact correction.
